meta.name: north-star-metric
meta.description: Define a North Star Metric and 3-5 supporting input metrics that form a metrics constellation. Classify the business game (Attention, Transaction, Productivity) and validate against 7 criteria for an effective North Star. Use when choosing a North Star Metric, setting up a metrics framework, learning about the North Star Framework, or deciding what to measure.

copy.tagline: 定义北极星指标并构建配套指标集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为产品选择核心度量指标并建立指标体系。
copy.tagline_en: Define a North Star Metric and build supporting metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are choosing a core product metric and building a measurement framework.

howto.what: 根据你提供的业务背景，分析并推荐一个北极星指标（North Star Metric）和3-5个输入指标，同时判断你的业务属于注意力、交易还是生产力游戏，并验证该指标是否符合7条有效标准。
howto.when: 当你需要定义关键指标、搭建指标框架、选择衡量什么，或提到“北极星指标”、“关键指标”、“metrics framework”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我为我的电商平台定义北极星指标。
say.note: Claude会分析你的业务并给出建议。

say.text: 我的SaaS产品属于哪种业务游戏？
验证这个北极星指标是否符合7条标准。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your business context to recommend a North Star Metric and 3-5 input metrics, classifies your business game (Attention, Transaction, or Productivity), and validates the metric against 7 criteria for an effective North Star.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to define key metrics, set up a metrics framework, decide what to measure, or mention keywords like 'North Star metric', 'key metric', 'metrics framework'.

say_en.text: Define a North Star metric for my e-commerce platform.
Which business game does my SaaS product belong to?
Validate this North Star metric against the 7 criteria.
